question: Give the code of the airport with the least flights.

args.sql: SELECT a.AirportCode, COUNT(f.FlightNo) AS n FROM airports a LEFT JOIN flights f ON TRIM(f.SourceAirport)=TRIM(a.AirportCode) OR TRIM(f.DestAirport)=TRIM(a.AirportCode) GROUP BY a.AirportCode ORDER BY n, a.AirportCode LIMIT 5

final_sql: SELECT a.AirportCode, COUNT(f.FlightNo) AS n FROM airports a LEFT JOIN flights f ON TRIM(f.SourceAirport)=TRIM(a.AirportCode) OR TRIM(f.DestAirport)=TRIM(a.AirportCode) GROUP BY a.AirportCode ORDER BY n, a.AirportCode LIMIT 5

question: What are the ids and names of all countries that either have more than 3 car makers or produce fiat model ?

args.sql:
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = c.CountryId GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
UNION
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = c.CountryId JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = m.Id WHERE ml.Model = 'fiat'
LIMIT 50

final_sql:
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = c.CountryId GROUP BY c.CountryId, c.CountryName HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
UNION
SELECT c.CountryId, c.CountryName FROM countries c JOIN car_makers m ON m.Country = c.CountryId JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = m.Id WHERE ml.Model = 'fiat'
LIMIT 50

question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .

final_sql: SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 INTERSECT SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker FROM car_makers cm JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id JOIN car_names cn ON cn.Model = ml.Model GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 LIMIT 100

question: Which dogs are of the rarest breed? Show their names and treatment dates.

args.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT breed_code, COUNT(*) n FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code) SELECT b.breed_name, c.n, d.name, t.date_of_treatment FROM c JOIN Breeds b ON b.breed_code=c.breed_code JOIN Dogs d ON d.breed_code=c.breed_code LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON t.dog_id=d.dog_id WHERE c.n=(SELECT MIN(n) FROM c) ORDER BY d.name, t.date_of_treatment LIMIT 50

final_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT breed_code, COUNT(*) n FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code) SELECT b.breed_name, c.n, d.name, t.date_of_treatment FROM c JOIN Breeds b ON b.breed_code=c.breed_code JOIN Dogs d ON d.breed_code=c.breed_code LEFT JOIN Treatments t ON t.dog_id=d.dog_id WHERE c.n=(SELECT MIN(n) FROM c) ORDER BY d.name, t.date_of_treatment LIMIT 50
